author: reek
body: A stencil-masked reveal. A rotating five-point star acts as a stencil: inside the star a swirling colour pattern shows through, outside is dark, and the star boundary is drawn as a bright outline -- the classic stencil use of masking one pass by the shape of another. One thread per pixel; the polar angle uses a rational atan2. Reference site's "stencil buffer" technique. Float math from DeviceMath.
